title: Topic 18
japanese_text: 経営不振だったA社に、B氏が<u>取締役</u>として<u>就任した</u>。その後、A社の経営方針は大幅に見直され、大規模な<u>リストラ</u>も行われた。<u>幹部</u>社員からの反発もあったが、B氏の大胆な<u>手腕</u>と仕事に対する<u>熱意</u>が伝わり、結果的にA社の業績は飛躍的に回復した。B氏の<u>功績</u>は大きかった。
english_translation: After Mr. B was appointed as a director of Company A, which had been in financial difficulty, the company's management policies were drastically revised and large-scale restructuring was implemented. Despite some opposition from top management, Mr. B's bold capability and enthusiasm for his job were well received, and as a result, Company A's performance has recovered dramatically. Mr. B's achievements were significant.
